notes.title: Pause Houses and Emotion Balloons
notes.content:
[h2]🏠 Pause Houses[/h2][p]You can now [b]pause the game[/b]! Just purchase a [b]Pause House[/b], and a new pause button will appear above the timer.[/p][p]While paused, your fish will sleep safely. 😴[/p][p]We're starting with [b]3 beautiful Pause Houses[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/e8afbb8a8501c3f5bc42f9ab93d0c8c95d2d5552.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Emotion Balloons[/h2][p]Fish now display [b]emotion balloons[/b] above their heads whenever their mood changes.
This makes it easier to understand how they’re feeling and take better care of them! ❤️🐟[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/d9f18eae1fef2204a870a4a19487523b98f92864.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Icons added to [b]Store[/b], [b]Ranking[/b], [b]Settings[/b], and [b]Move[/b] buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Animated color change in the [b]status ball[/b] when minimized[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Timer no longer stays active after closing and reopening the end-game screen[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Cause of death now clearly shown in red text[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Mouse icon now hidden during move action[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Screen position resets correctly after using the Help, Minimize, or Exit buttons[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]: All fish textures now display properly during the flop animation[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Local fish names now correctly shown in the ranking[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Don't kill the fish v1.1.3
notes.content: [p]We’ve streamlined the interface to focus on rankings🏆! Now, you can see your current position along with up to 4 players above and below you. If your friends are near your rank, you’ll spot their names on the leaderboard! 🐟[/p][p]Remember: The fish that survives the longest wins! 🐠[/p]

notes.title: Don't kill the fish v1.1.2
notes.content:
Update Highlights:

🏆 New Steam Achievement: First Death.

🐟 Fish turns red when it's close to dying.

✅ Bug fix: Input name field is now auto-focused on start.

✅ Bug fix:: Settings, Store, and History panels now close properly when minimizing or leaving the aquarium.

notes.title: Don't kill the fish v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's New?[/h1][p]
[b]Card Purchase Mechanic:[/b] You can now use a debit card to buy items. Purchases are only made if you have enough money. There are 6 card levels—starting with a basic card that allows auto-buy for just 1 item. As your score increases, you unlock higher-level cards with greater auto-buy limits, making it easier to keep your fish safe. Click the card to enable or disable auto-buy for an item. For example, see the [i]Plant[/i] item with auto-buy active.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/cce72fbd018211b53e9853f11527dab95c8d0d27.png"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Automatic Help Consumable:[/b] A new consumable item has been added to help your fish. If your fish jumps out of the aquarium, you can now use the auto-help item to bring it back. Check how many you have by clicking the snail to open the settings. After 5 seconds, a help button will appear and automatically save your fish.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/a7e62fe919caf73d05974af243dec37c5b4f6dbc.png"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Timer Improvements:[/b] The in-game timer now displays minutes and hours.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/1d4818203332486bbe9af359c1059086e0adeb42.png"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Brightness Control:[/b] A brightness slider has been added to the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/5f601708e0c6a25126e410559844c7209dae1995.png"][/img]

[b]Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] The ball no longer appears in the aquarium after auto-save when the game is minimized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Food no longer increases when the fish is dead.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] The game now loads without automatically opening menus.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Menu panels now block the config panel from being hidden or shown while they are open.


By

notes.title: Inside the aquarium from "Don't kill the fish"
notes.content:
[p]Today I'm going to give you 3 tips to keep your fish from going to fish heaven. 

First, 

The green minimize button can be very practical for taking care of your fish without losing focus on what you're doing. When you minimize the game, you won't see the aquarium anymore. You'll see a little ball in the right corner of the screen. If it's green, don't worry, your fish is fine. If it's yellow, you can check to see if it doesn't need anything. Now the ball is red, you need to see your fish right away. It needs you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/c754b83a13dae56fc4e6b47f4c8b4720ecf32774.png"][/img][/p][p]Second, 

Clean the aquarium by left-clicking on it. You'll see a cleaning animation like the one below. Click until you can't see it anymore and your aquarium will be clean. Or, wait for the clean button, which will clean it all at once. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/b536f47459a0594d1931c22494d92cae6f9d5405.png"][/img][/p][p]Third, 

Give your fish affection by clicking the left mouse button, but don't overdo it or it might get irritated, and then that little ball up there in the first tip will start to go red. See the animation of the fish being affectionate below:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/76a6bfe109292234582676aad2c7110aaf2bbe2b.png"][/img][/p][p]By

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/fb452819d8ea4a908bda24fe5a051067e696504e.png"][/img][/p]
